_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in game of LinesOfAction.
Your pieces are '{side}', opponent pieces are '{other}'.
Move format: `[b1b3]` (from-coord to-coord). A legal move travels horizontally, vertically, or diagonally a number of squares equal to the total pieces (any colour) in that line. You may jump over your own pieces, but not opponent pieces; landing on an opponent captures it.  Win when all your pieces are 8-neighbour connected.

invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: චලනය කෙළින් හෝ විකර්ණ විය යුතුයි.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: එක පෙළේ තියෙන කොටස් වලට සමාන දුරක් යන්න ඕන.

game_action.captured_suffix: ක් රීඩකයා {player_id} {from} -> {to} වෙත ගමන් කරමින් සතුරා අල්ලා ගනී.
